title: Fabric OneLake and lakehouse mental model
summary: Treat OneLake as the storage layer and Fabric workloads as engines/surfaces over governed data products.

blocks.text: Treat OneLake as the storage layer and Fabric workloads as engines/surfaces over governed data products.

items: OneLake provides a unified data lake abstraction for Fabric items.
Lakehouse combines files and managed table semantics for analytics workloads.
Shortcuts can reference data without physically copying everything.
Workspace/item security and underlying data permissions must be designed together.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
